Real Vehicle Breakdowns
General Overview
Mod Overview

The Real Vehicle Breakdowns (RVB) mod aims to make vehicle operation more realistic and unpredictable in Farming Simulator 25. The mod introduces a complex breakdown and maintenance system in which vehicle components have their own service life. Usage, operating hours, engine load, operating temperature and maintenance can all affect the condition of vehicles. Improper operation and neglected maintenance can lead to premature wear, breakdowns and, in extreme cases, complete vehicle failure. Breakdowns can affect various systems, including engine operation, the cooling system, electrical equipment, the starting system and lighting. Battery condition, charge level and ambient temperature can also affect engine starting. Vehicle condition can be monitored through the RVB's dedicated interface. The workshop system allows inspections, scheduled maintenance and repairs to be carried out. The associated costs are influenced by factors such as vehicle value and age. The aim of RVB is to make vehicle operation about more than just getting the job done: monitoring machine condition, performing proper maintenance and dealing with unexpected breakdowns also become part of the gameplay.
Main Features
Real Vehicle Breakdowns manages several systems that affect vehicle operation, condition and reliability.
Maintenance and Component Lifespan

Vehicle components have a defined service life. Operating hours, intensity of use and maintenance all affect their condition. The system allows periodic maintenance, inspections and necessary repairs to be carried out.
Vehicles can experience various mechanical and electrical faults. Breakdowns can affect engine performance, starting, cooling, lighting and the operation of electrical systems.
Battery and Electrical System
Battery charge level, condition and temperature affect engine starting. Lighting and other electrical consumers use power, while the running alternator recharges the battery.
Workshop and Repairs
Vehicle condition can be checked, maintenance performed and repairs carried out in the workshop. Each procedure has its own duration and cost.
Customizable Gameplay
The mod settings allow you to customize breakdown difficulty, maintenance intervals and other operating parameters.
Battery System
Battery Overview
Battery Capacity
Battery capacity is measured in amp-hours (Ah).
Battery Connections
Vehicles can use parallel or series battery configurations.
Engine Starting
Starting Requirements
The battery must provide sufficient cranking current for the engine.
